# Vibhaṅga-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Abh02a)

**ID:** Atk Abh02a
**Section:** Sammohavinodanī-aṭṭhakathā (atk-abh02)
**Collection:** Atthakatha-Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Vibhaṅga-aṭṭhakathā
**Title (English, from literature):** The Dispeller of Delusion
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sammohavinodanī* (also known as the *Vibhaṅga-aṭṭhakathā*) is the canonical commentary on the *Vibhaṅga*, the second book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Nyanaponika and Bodhi 2012]. It is one of the three authoritative commentaries covering the Abhidhamma collection, standing alongside the *Atthasālinī* (on the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi*) and the *Pañcappakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* (on the remaining five treatises) [Nyanaponika and Bodhi 2012]. The work is ascribed to Ācariya Buddhaghosa, who arrived in Sri Lanka from India during the fifth century CE and compiled the commentary using the older Sinhalese commentarial material preserved at the Mahāvihāra in Anuradhapura [Nyanaponika and Bodhi 2012]. The Pali text was edited for the Pali Text Society by A. P. Buddhadatta [Endo 1997; Somboon Wat Ana 2003], and has been published in English translation as *The Dispeller of Delusion* [Symposium 2010].

In terms of textual reuse, DharmaNexus detects extensive overlap between the *Sammohavinodanī* and other Theravāda treatises, amounting to 76,775 matching segments across 485 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest reuse correspondences occur with the two parts of Buddhaghosa's *Visuddhimagga* (over 830,000 shared characters combined), featuring long passages with over 95% similarity (such as §1137_1–1186_4 matching *Visuddhimagga* §1505_0–1562_4) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares substantial textual segments with the *Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi*, and the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā*, as well as being expounded in its subcommentary, the *Vibhaṅga-mūlaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meet the threshold in DharmaNexus [DharmaNexus].

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Visuddhimaggo (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Anya E0101n) (§1137_1–1186_4 ↔ §1505_0–1562_4); Visuddhimaggo (Dutiyo bhāgo) (Anya E0102n) (§717_3–777 ↔ §1006_5–1073); Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0201a) (§1591_2–1645 ↔ §1251_1–1299_0); Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0517a) (§514_0–527_7 ↔ §679_3–692_8); Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi (Tika Abh09t) (§990_8–994_4 ↔ §1929_8–1933_4); Dīghanikāye Mahāvaggaṭṭhakathā (Atk S0102a) (§1317–1362_6 ↔ §1584_0–1618_6); Saṃyuttanikāye Mahāvagga-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0305a) (§1591_7–1645 ↔ §330_4–380_0); Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0515a) (§1573_1–1577_3 ↔ §1749_0–1755_3)
